english: ...It's the weapon shop... I always rely on them...\n...M-maybe I'll say hello...
Hm?\nWhat is it? You, child?
...Child!? ...Aaaah, that's me,\nI'm Claude.\nI always see you at the shop, so I thought I'd greet you...
Hm. To greet me out of courtesy...\nYou're a well-raised child, aren't you.
Here, a candy as your reward... *rustle rustle*.
(Warashi? ...Oh, she means a child...\nThough she looks younger than me...)
Um... weapon shop lady...
What? I'm not at the shop now, so\nfeel free to call me Lady Dorothy, or Miss Dorothy.
Y-yes... then, Lady Dor...othy?
Hm, what is it? You look like a child\nwith many questions. Ask me anything.
U-um, Lady Dor...othy,\nhow... old are you now?
Fuu~. You're a child so it can't be helped, but\nasking a woman her age shows a lack of\nthe most basic etiquette.
Even a woman of experience like me\nhas the heart of a maiden, forever and always.
(No, she clearly looks younger than me though...)
The child just wanted to act a bit grown-up, hmm?\nWell, in that case, I'll pretend\nI never heard it.
(I-I feel like that just got swept under the rug!?)
Lady Dorothy, why are you so beautiful?
Y-you... flattering people despite being a child...\nYou're a creepy one. At this rate,\nI worry about your future.
I may need to re-educate\nthat rotten nature of yours\nin place of your parents.
First, I don't like\nthat fidgety attitude!\nLook people in the eye when you speak!!
Honestly, young people these days...\nSpoil them a little and this is what you get.
When I was young,\nthere were ever so many\nstalwart gentlemen, you know~.
Back then, they were heroes who saved the world,\nor masters of a one-hit-kill fist art\nthat only one person could learn.
There were even those who could pull\nall sorts of items from a mysterious pocket, you know~.
How lamentable,\nthat a child like you\nwould come to this town...
...Haah, it's not like I came\nto this town because I wanted to...
Well, this too may be\nthe flow of the times~.
Perhaps it means I've grown old.
(No, you're a kid...\nBut she'd get mad if I pointed that out...)
Child, from now on you will\nlisten well to what I say.
Y-yes...
Your reply lacks spirit!
YES!! (Ugh...)
L-Lady Dorothy?
What is it? Child?
Lady Dorothy, do you like spicy food?
What? I am an adult!\nI'd never eat sweets\nthat women and children like!!
R-right?\nActually, when I was traveling alone, in an eastern country\nI got my hands on a strange food in a pack...
Oh, the eastern lands?\nThey were once called the land of gold~.
Gold!? There wasn't any, but\nI thought you might like this food\nyou pour this yellow liquid over...
This Bonjour Curry just needs 3 minutes in hot water,\nthen pour it over steaming rice and it's a masterpiece.\nP-please, have some!
Hoho, how convenient~\nFood from that golden land... Long ago, when I traveled,\neveryone gave me all sorts of souvenirs.
Well, since the child made it for me,\nI suppose I'll partake...
Th-this is!!\nSooooo goooood!!!\nM-my, child, such a wonderful thing!!
The moment it touches my tongue, the aroma of eastern culture spreads,\nthe sweetness of the vegetables melting into the rice—\nmy mouth is a treasure box!
Y-you... have you no shame? Plotting\nsome scheme to bribe me again?
It's because you're always scheming like that\nthat you have THAT face!!
Child, have you never thought to talk\nto people without scheming for gain?\nTruly, how lamentable!
...Still, this food you offered... not bad\nat all! Though it'd be better\nwithout your nosy prying.
Hm, well done!\nIt was most delicious.
Child, if you go to the eastern lands again,\nI'm counting on you.
...I-it's not spicy?
I've told you! Once one is as adult as me,\nspicy or sweet, it matters not!
(So maybe she really is an adult inside that child's body...\nI must be careful...)
I-I couldn't eat it. Too spicy for me.
Hm. For children, I recall there was\nsomething called Star Prince Curry\nin the eastern lands.
I see. If I get the chance, I'd love\nto try that one!
Indeed. If you visit the eastern lands again,\ndo call on me.
I have an old friend there;\nI'd ask you to carry a message.
Lady Dorothy, you have a friend\nin the eastern lands?
W-well... but he rarely\nshows himself before people~.
Well, if you bring his favorite fried tofu,\nhe'll surely show his face.
I don't know what 'oage' is, but\nunderstood... though I can't go\nuntil this journey ends...
Indeed, the eastern lands...\nHow nostalgic~...
Hmm~mm, these recent machines...
...Huh? That's Dorothy from the weapon shop...\nShe looks troubled.
Is something the matter?
Oh! You came at just the right time!!\nDo you know how to use this?
(This is a cell phone? And a flip one at that.)
I think I get it... may I?\nYou flip it open like this, enter the other\nparty's number, and place the call.
Nwo! S-so it's a communication device!\nWh-what, it sends no video, only voice...\nWhat an unreliable device... terrifying!
No, this is the miniaturized version, supposedly...\nBefore this they were huge things you slung over your shoulder...
Wh-what!? Slung over the shoulder!?\nLike a small plastic bomb!!\nWhat an end-of-the-century sight!
...Well, they ARE a product of the century's end...\nHuh?? How do I know that!?
Y-you don't even know that?
Wh-whaaat! Are you mocking me!\nEeeeye, just watch! In my hands,\na weird machine like this is...
U-uuuh, what a frail, fleeting machine.\nThis'd be no use in battle!
A-anyway, this just proves\nI don't need such a thing!
You there, child! Dispose of this thing\nthat failed to meet my eye!
But... what happened to it?
No, it suddenly fell from the sky.
It made strange noises now and then, so\nI thought I'd save it... but\nI've lost patience with it!
Still, it's strange to think there was\nan age when such things ran rampant.
Not using bodies like ours that can\ntransmit instantly from positional data—\nhow inconvenient~.
?? Using... bodies??
Nwo!\nYou, what are you staring at my body for...
Wh-what a creepy child~.
A child like you taking interest in\nan adult woman's body like mine\nis far too early.
Gain more experience,\nand come before me once you're a full adult!
Now, if you understand, begone, begone!
Uuuuh, I don't really get it, but\nsorry, sorry, sorry.
Hoho, now this!!\nThis looks quite handy!
W-wwoah!! Wh-!? Enemies!?
Gotta run! Gotta run! Gotta run!!
Ohhh, sorry sorry,\nI didn't think a child would be there.
A weapon sample arrived, so\nI was testing how it works.
It's some weapon combining a cannon and a spear...\nI'd never seen one, and fiddling with it\nblind, it went off.
They say it's a fine piece that can take down\nscreeching giant birds and ancient dragons!\nAmazing, no~!!
I-I don't need such dangerous gear.\nResolving things peacefully is best...\nI think...
Fuu~, you don't get it~. Equipping\nmighty weapons makes a man's worth\nskyrocket. Well, this one's especially flashy~.
Well, it's not heavy artillery, but\nthere's this fish-shaped sword,\nor this monster-mouth flute! How about it?
If it's no trouble... where did you get them?
Hohhohho, trade secret!\nI source them through special channels I can't reveal, but\n...I'll tell you just a little.
In another dimension there's a bunch hunting\nall kinds of giant creatures,\nand they divert their goods to me cheap!
How's that?\nYou're starting to want one, no?\nNo?
Right now, I'll even throw in\na cat-shaped robot to travel with you!\nHow's that?
N-no thanks... I hate fighting...\nReally...
Truly lamentable.
No 'don the armor and protect thy lord!'?
Um, who's my lord?
*sparkle sparkle sparkle*☆\nHm? What's wrong?
N-no, it's just, your stare hurts...
(Let's slip away before she notices)\n...*scurry scurry*...
Look, isn't this muzzle elegant &\nsexy! And and...\na bargain like this is rare!
Not getting this?\nThe what-a-waste ghost will come out!
Huh? She's gone!?\nHeeey, heeey, heeey.
Ah! Lady Dorothy!!
Wwaah!!\nWh-what!?
A-are you okay?\nSorry for calling out so suddenly.
...U-uuuuh, bwaaaah!
Waaah, sorry sorry sorry sorry.
One! Two! Three...\nYou'll take a three-count at this rate?
Hn!? Lady Dorothy??\nSomething's off about her tone...
*sniff*, *sniffle*, it hurts, mooom,\nwaaah, waaah.
U-um... Lady Dorothy? What kind of joke is this?
Waaah, waaaah,\nthis big brother is scaryyy,\nwaaah, waaah.
Um, uh, er, I feel like something terrible is happening!?
*hic*, *hic*, who's big brother?\nDid you do something to Dorothy?
I wanna go hooome,\nwaaah, waaah.
Home... the shop is fine, right?\nI'll take you there.
Really! Big brother, thank you!\nYou're nice!
Y-yeah... what is this?\nLady Dorothy's gone all childish... though I guess\nit matches how she looks...
Um, um.
Yes? What is it?
Um, big brother,\ncan we hold hands?
Y-yeah, if my hand's good enough.
Yay, yaaay!\nWith big brother ♪\nWith big brother ♪
F-first, let's get to the shop and ask Rin!!
Bweh! Big brother,\nyou were just thinking about some other girl besides Dorothy!
Bad big brothers like that\nget chomp-chomped!
*nom nom nom.*
...U-uh, that tickles...
S-stop it, Lady Dor...othy...
Not Lady Dorothy —\nDorothy-chan!
Dorothy likes big brother!\nEhehe.
W-waaah, my inner demon that absolutely\nMUST NOT come out is about to surface, so\nlet's hurry to the shop!!
Phew~. But last time really surprised me.\nThe moment we reached the shop, Rin went pale\nand dragged Lady Dorothy off...
Ah, Dorothy-chan!\nAre you okay?
Dorothy-chan?
You, calling me '-chan'...\nyou've grown bold, haven't you~.
Huh? Huuuh??
I have no memory of last time at all, but\nit seems Rin restored my data\nfrom just before that point.
It's deeply unpleasant that some data is corrupted,\nbut it can't be helped.
Now, what shall I do with a child\nwho calls me '-chan'...
Sorry, sorry, sorry...\nLady Dorothy... if you don't mind...\ndo you have any new weapons...
Oh, you've started wanting weapons too!!\nGood, wait right there...\nSomething even a child could handle...
Come on, it's Dorothy-chan — it's big brother!\nWhat's wrong?
Child... keep that up and I'll slice you\nwith the twin swords in the warehouse\nthat belonged to a foreign girl!
They say she was an apprentice warrior, yet\nshe had techniques that could destroy the Earth.
Now, wait there while I go to the warehouse!
(Now's my chance... soft steps... sneak...ing...)
Aaaah, sorry sorry sorry,\nI wasn't trying to run away or anything...
H-huh, big brother?
Mooou, you're heavy~. Move off, quick~.
Huh~? Or maybe\nyou don't want to leave Dorothy?
Mooou! Big brother's being naughty.
...Th-this is!?
Either way, sorry sorry sorry,\nI'll leap away immediately!\nI'll prostrate myself into the ground!!
Nn! Ch-ch, nooo~,\nbig brother... you can't\ntouch me there.
W-w-w, I'm no good...\nI'm gonna faint............ *phweee*.
...Hmph, so this is what this one likes?\nWhat a creep, honestly... but...\nnow and then, this isn't so bad. Ufufu.
L-L-L... Lady Dorothy-chan!!
Hah? Whoa whoa, calm down, calm down.\nFirst, take a deep breath, okay?
*breathe in, breathe out, breathe in, breathe out,\nbreathe in, breathe out, breathe in, breathe out*
Hey, how long are you going to keep that up!?\nYou're going to give ME breathing trouble.
*pant pant pant*, sorry, I lost my composure.
...Um... are you Lady Dorothy?\nOr Dorothy-chan?
Fuu~. Didn't I tell you not to call me '-chan'?\nOr do you fancy yourself my husband?
N-no, I'm so sorry, but\nthere are times when Lady Dorothy transforms, you see...
Fuu, that's become quite the strange title.\nWell, it's amusing in its own way,\nso I'll allow it.
Um... is Dorothy-chan\nLady Dorothy? Or...
Fuu, you saw me in an embarrassing state, child.\nIt's true — in my infancy everyone called me\nDorothy-chan and doted on me.
But yesterday, for some reason a system error occurred\nand my memory data regressed to infancy, it seems.\nWell, the me of that era was naive about the world, unlike now~.
(Uwaah~. The cause of the system error...\nwas me. I should NOT say that.)
Lady Dorothy... um, did you have a husband?
Fuh, memories of the distant past...\nso many wonderful people stayed by my side...\nI was young then~.
(Hm? 'Everyone'? Um, not just one...\nno, I feel like I shouldn't ask...)
What's wrong?\nGone all quiet? You're drenched in sweat?
Ha! Sorry,\nn-n-n-nothing at all~.
You're a strange child~.\nOf all the men I know,\nnone were like you~.
But you, child... how to put it, you tickle\nmy maternal instincts... I just\ncan't leave you alone.
Ha!? Could this be\nyour scheme!?
If so... you may be\nquite the player~.
Th-that's not it at all...\nBut, Lady Dorothy, I feel...\nsomething... a strange feeling too...
Now now,\ndon't tease adults.
I-it's my bedtime now! T-take care\nnot to catch cold! And brush your teeth!
Huh... wha...\nshe vanished like she was running away...\nwhat was that about?
Huh? This place... a school?\nBut why am I in a place like this...
There's a sign... 'Café Iron Fist'?\n...Maybe I'll understand if I go in?
B-big brother, welcome.
Lady Dorothy!? No, Dorothy-chan...
Um, Dorothy asked\nif she could see big brother.
And the Mother System said 'just this once'\nand opened the event flag for me.
Wh-what's this about... but\nI'm glad to see you too.
Also, um, Dorothy's been hiding it, but...\nmy ears and tail...
Yes, they're very cute.
R-really!! I was so worried\nyou'd hate me, big brother...\nthis whole time.
I'd never hate you.\nBoth Lady Dorothy and Dorothy-chan are precious to me.
Ehehe, I'm so happy~.\nI love you, big brother~.
Today, I got them to make me\nyour personal maid, big brother... so...
Wh-what!? S-so...!?
Fuu~. Now, child,\nyou'll catch cold sleeping in a place like this.
Drooling...\ngrinning like that, how creepy~.
Ah, huh!?\nJust the two of us, just for today... huh...
Huh? Dorothy's in her shop uniform...\nWhere's the miko outfit? The fox ears?
Nnh!
You... how do you know about that...
Huh? The ears and tail?\nThat was a dream, though...
Now that you've seen...
I'll seal your lips!
Hieyah!
Hyih! D-don't shqueeze my cheeks!
Wh-what are you shaying!?
I'm sealing your lips.
Until you're good and sorry and don't feel like talking,\nI'll keep you like this.
You can just stay like this, fox-pinched.
Um... I think that idiom means something else.\nBut this is, well, literally... being pinched.
